title: Disclosure Manifest Verifier
description: Verifies a disclosure manifest's eddsa-jcs-2022 signature, proves a single file's Merkle inclusion against a manifest's root, and runs a full present/missing/mismatched coverage report of a folder against a manifest.

manifest.description: The disclosure manifest to check against

files.description: Files selected in the browser for verification

mcp_tool_definition.name: verify_disclosure_inclusion
mcp_tool_definition.description: Verifies a Merkle inclusion proof for a file digest against a disclosure manifest's root, given the manifest's entry list. Use to prove a specific document was part of a disclosed set at a given version.

manifest.description: The disclosure manifest to check against

path.description: Path of the entry to prove

digest.description: sha256:-prefixed digest of the file to prove
